instruction: How much does my amazon cart and wishlist cost in total, ignoring potential tax and delivery fees?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes may occur, so only lookup actions are modeled (login, show_cart, show_wish_list). The cart total and wish-list total are runtime amount objects discovered by the two show actions; the static (sum-of cart-total wishlist-total combined-total) fact ties the final answer object to both lookups so supervisor-complete-task can only fire once both have been retrieved. The agent computes the numeric sum (price*quantity for each item, no tax or delivery) and passes it as the answer. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
